overview.description: The Innovator Defined Wealth Shield ETF (BALT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 index. The fund aims to participate in the price movement of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (ticker: SPY), up to a cap while buffering the first 15-20% decline. The fund resets it's buffer and cap levels every three-months BALT was launched on Jul 1, 2021 and is issued by Innovator.
